_meta.note: What the law fixes about each option, and nothing else. There are no return figures anywhere in this file, deliberately: a return is a forecast, not a rule, and this system does not present forecasts as facts. The comparison reports the tax saving, which is computable, alongside the terms, which are statutory.

options.name: Employees' Provident Fund
options.lockInNote: Until you leave employment, with limited early withdrawal
options.suits: Already happening if you are salaried. Deducted from your pay before you see it.
options._source: Structural facts only: the section, the lock-in and the tax treatment. NOT YET VERIFIED.

options.name: Equity Linked Savings Scheme
options.lockInNote: Three years, the shortest of the 80C options
options.taxOnMaturity: capital gains apply above a threshold
options.suits: Someone with a long horizon who was going to hold equity anyway.
options._source: Structural facts only: the section, the lock-in and the tax treatment. NOT YET VERIFIED.

options.name: Public Provident Fund
options.lockInNote: Fifteen years, with partial withdrawal allowed later
options.suits: The part of your savings that should not move with a market.
options._source: Structural facts only: the section, the lock-in and the tax treatment. NOT YET VERIFIED.

options.name: National Savings Certificate
options.taxOnMaturity: interest is taxable, though reinvested interest may itself qualify
options.suits: A fixed term with no market exposure.
options._source: Structural facts only: the section, the lock-in and the tax treatment. NOT YET VERIFIED.

options.name: Tax-saving fixed deposit
options.taxOnMaturity: interest is fully taxable each year
options.suits: Familiar and simple. The taxable interest is what makes it weaker than it looks.
options._source: Structural facts only: the section, the lock-in and the tax treatment. NOT YET VERIFIED.

options.name: Life insurance premium
options.character: protection, sometimes with a savings element
options.taxOnMaturity: exempt subject to premium and sum assured conditions
options.suits: Protection first. A policy bought for the deduction alone usually serves neither purpose well.
options._source: Structural facts only: the section, the lock-in and the tax treatment. NOT YET VERIFIED.

options.name: National Pension System, additional
options.character: market linked, mixed equity and debt
options.taxOnMaturity: partly exempt, part must buy an annuity which is taxable
options.suits: Room over and above the 80C ceiling, for money you will not need before retirement.
options._source: Structural facts only: the section, the lock-in and the tax treatment. NOT YET VERIFIED.

options.name: Health insurance premium
options.risk: none, it is cover rather than an investment
options.suits: A separate ceiling from 80C, so it does not compete with your investments.
options._source: Structural facts only: the section, the lock-in and the tax treatment. NOT YET VERIFIED.
